issue.title: [META: WAIT FOR EVIDENCE] Final upstream promotion DAG + posting queue
issue.body:
## Status: CANONICAL META / WAIT FOR EVIDENCE

This is the single owner for the final Waves 9–10 posting queue. Older promotion-DAG ticket #62 was closed into this issue.

Do not create more CUA upstream streams while core evidence is outstanding.

## Current assimilated/ready items

- #4164: **MERGED**; screenshot-only verifier producer proof complete.
- #4196 / downstream #2: **FULLY QUALIFIED / CLOSED**. Controlled skip/fallback evidence plus released real-perception and live Linux foreground-escalation evidence are complete.
- #3946: internal polling provenance assimilated.
- #4009: public observation provenance accepted at RFC/proposal level.
- #3873: snapshot freshness owner identified.
- #3961: maintainer requested a **re-cut**, not a wholesale rebase. Remaining value is split into #77 OpenJev backend + #78 browser provider parity/backend receipts.
- #2794: canonical mechanical batch owner; #3494 should consolidate into it.
- #4052: **MERGED**; browser phase timing is canonical. #75 owns the behavior-neutral native timing parity follow-up.

## Current waits

- #4316: structural/runtime evidence is now positive (2→1 provider decisions; guarded route exact; independent fixture verified); current head `d391a663` contains the CI-test repair and needs exact-head rerun/CI approval.
- #4317 / #36: real two-session isolation evidence is positive (25 cross-use attempts, 0 accepted/mutations on corrected local harness). Current head `52d379c8` fixes import + typed ActionResult refusal handling and strengthens end→restart authority retirement; needs exact-head rerun.
- #4318: current head `b55326f6` adds the portable/live `pattern` implication rule and canonical-token tests after local CI found the missing compatibility gate. Needs exact-head rerun.
- #76: **COMPLETE / CLOSED**. Fresh current Linux `tools/list` census measured 182,949 B / 37,881 `o200k_base` tokens on main and identified current repetition owners before any broad compression.
- #3904/#8: RFC decision + native passive-observation implementation/evidence.
- #3796/#9: RFC decision + admission/cleanup evidence.
- #3492/#72: exact-head macOS Rust A/B.
- #3906/#13: macOS slow-read runtime evidence.
- #16/#19/#31: externally delegated cross-platform rows.
- #77/#78: provider salvage after the current speed-critical local wave.

## Output format

For every surviving upstream action:
`delta → canonical owner → exact SHA → completed evidence → missing evidence → action type → dependency → stop condition`

Only post when the prerequisite evidence is present. Prefer updating existing issues/PRs over creating new ones.

## Posting quality gate

An upstream packet is **READY NOW** only when it contains:
- canonical owner/link;
- exact candidate SHA;
- forced-path fixture/state;
- route/path attribution;
- independent outcome oracle;
- negative/fallback control;
- precise claim boundary;
- reason no competing implementation stream is needed.

If a result was produced on an old head, mark it historical and recertify the changed behavior. If the intended route was not exercised, do not use that run as promotion evidence.

Prefer upstream absorption of an invariant/test over preserving downstream PR ownership. #4196 absorbing #4165 is the model.

## Latest posting-state updates — 2026-09-26

- #4196: **MERGED**. Do not create another implementation stream. Runtime evidence packet #2 now owns only real perception + foreground-escalation qualification.
- #18: **CLOSED / architectural decision complete**. Mac AX events remain invalidators/hints only; no conditional-observation promotion.
- #17: **CLOSED / assimilated** into existing browser ref invalidation/session/generation owners.
- #4236: **ACTIVE UPSTREAM PR** for #4012 Wayland presentation evidence. Existing structure is acceptable; remaining gates are hosted/native lane execution and maintainer CI/scope review.


## Current critical path

1. **#4316** — execute exact head locally; prove the guarded route deletes exactly one provider decision while preserving fresh-ref authority and current #4052 timing.
2. **#4317 / #36** — prove two-session authority isolation on the real Driver/MCP/Chromium path.
3. **#10** — ingest those exact heads into the independently verified whole-task A/B; report structural work deletion separately from wall-clock movement.
4. **#4318** — rerun the portable/live contract gate on `b55326f6`; #76 measurement is closed.
5. **#75** — local telemetry-only patch exists at `2e07f6769`; keep `visual_observe_scope: "parse_only"` so browser/native timing scopes are not falsely equated, then push/review + one exact-head smoke.
6. **#77 → #78** — backend-only OpenJev re-cut has started downstream on `salvage/openjev-decision-model-20260928`; do not promote until its real loopback HTTP/security matrix passes.

Already closed/assimilated: #2, #4, #5, #24, #33, #40, #64, #68, #69, #70.
